name: IG-11
description: IG-11, also known as Eyegee-Eleven or simply as IG or Eyegee, was a IG-series assassin droid who was a bounty hunter during the New Republic Era. IG-11 was programmed to follow the protocols of the Bounty Hunters' Guild, and had a built-in self-destruct mechanism to prevent itself from being captured while working as a hired gun.

data.name: IG-11
data.birth: Before or during the Galactic Civil War, a factory
death: 9 ABY, Nevarro (later repurposed as IG-12) (later rebuilt from IG-12's remains)
